may-break.mechanism: From PHP 8.2 strtolower(), strtoupper(), stristr(), stripos(), strripos(), lcfirst(), ucfirst(), ucwords() and str_ireplace() ignore the locale and convert ASCII case only, as if the locale were C.
may-break.title: PHP 8.2 makes strtolower(), strtoupper() and related functions ignore the locale

may-break.mechanism: PHP 8.1 deprecates implementing an internal interface method without a compatible return type or the #[\ReturnTypeWillChange] attribute.
may-break.title: PHP 8.1 deprecates implementing an internal interface method without a compatible return type

version-boundary.mechanism: From PHP 8.0 the concatenation operator has lower precedence than addition, subtraction and bitshifts, so an unparenthesised sum in a concatenation is evaluated before the concatenation.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.0 gives + and - higher precedence than the concatenation operator

version-boundary.mechanism: PHP 8.1 changes the default flags of htmlspecialchars(), htmlentities() and related functions from ENT_COMPAT to ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.1 changes the default flags of htmlspecialchars() and related functions to ENT_QUOTES

version-boundary.mechanism: PHP 8 raises a TypeError for arithmetic and bitwise operations on strings that PHP 7 only warned about, and warns where PHP 7 raised a notice.

sources.section: Other incompatible Changes: numeric string handling

version-boundary.title: PHP 8 throws TypeError for arithmetic on non-numeric strings

version-boundary.mechanism: The PHP 8.0 page lists create_function() as removed (anonymous functions may be used instead), each() as removed (foreach or ArrayIterator should be used instead) and the __autoload() ability as removed (spl_autoload_register() should be used instead).
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.0 removes create_function(), each() and __autoload()

version-boundary.mechanism: The PHP 8.0 page states that the default error handling mode for PDO has been changed from silent to exceptions.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.0 changes the PDO default error mode from silent to exceptions

version-boundary.mechanism: The PHP 8.1 page states that the default mysqli error handling mode has been changed from silent to exceptions, and refers to the MySQLi reporting mode page for restoring the old behaviour.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.1 changes the mysqli default error mode from silent to exceptions

version-boundary.mechanism: The PHP 8.0 page states that the @ operator no longer silences the listed fatal error levels, and that error handlers that expected error_reporting to be 0 under @ should use a mask check instead.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.0 stops the @ operator from silencing fatal errors

version-boundary.mechanism: PHP 8.1 deprecates passing null to non-nullable parameters of built-in functions, to align them with user-defined functions where scalar types must be marked nullable explicitly.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.1 deprecates passing null to non-nullable parameters of built-in functions

version-boundary.mechanism: PHP 8.2 deprecates creating dynamic properties unless the class uses the #[\AllowDynamicProperties] attribute.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.2 deprecates creating dynamic properties on classes that do not declare them

version-boundary.mechanism: PHP 8 casts the number to a string and compares strings when the other operand is non-numeric, so loose comparisons that were true in PHP 7 are false.

sources.section: PHP Core: String to Number Comparison

version-boundary.title: PHP 8 compares a number with a non-numeric string as strings

version-boundary.mechanism: PHP 8.0 removes support for the reversed implode() parameter order, $pieces before $glue.
version-boundary.title: PHP 8.0 removes the reversed implode($pieces, $glue) argument order

will-break.mechanism: PHP 8.1 emits a deprecated notice when an internal interface method is implemented without a compatible return type, and vfsStream 1.6.8 and 1.6.9 implement getIterator() without one.

sources.section: getIterator() declares #[\ReturnTypeWillChange] at v1.6.10; v1.6.9 and v1.6.8 declare none

will-break.title: PHP 8.1 breaks vfsStream releases before 1.6.10 that override getIterator() without a return type
